name: Wiccans
overview: Scripture clearly condemns the practice of witchcraft and engaging with familiar spirits, warning believers to avoid such practices as defiling and opposed to God's holiness. The Old Testament commands that witches and wizards not be allowed to live, emphasizing the severity of these sins. Furthermore, the New Testament warns that sorcerers and those who practice occult arts will face eternal judgment in the lake of fire, highlighting the spiritual peril involved. Believers are called to trust in the Lord alone and reject all forms of enchantment and occultism.
